name: io.github.shawnwollenberg/walletlens
description: EVM wallet reports and Robinhood Stock Token intelligence paid with USDC over x402.

environmentVariables.description: Dedicated agent-wallet private key for paid x402 tools.
environmentVariables.name: WALLETLENS_X402_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Maximum USDC allowed for one report. Defaults to 0.02.
environmentVariables.name: WALLETLENS_MAX_PAYMENT_USDC

environmentVariables.description: WalletLens API origin. Defaults to the production service.
environmentVariables.name: WALLETLENS_BASE_URL
